cards.f: Why is a relief print reversed?
cards.b: The image flips when printed, like a stamp, so plan text and direction in reverse.
Cut away from hands, keep hands behind the blade, use a bench hook or non-slip mat.
Roll ink thin and even on a plate (crackling sound), then roll over the block in several directions.
An artwork made by sticking paper, fabric or other materials onto a surface.
A composite image made by cutting and joining photographs; Hannah Höch.

short.q: Explain how to make a multi-colour reduction print.
short.model: Print the lightest colour first, carve away more of the same block, print the next colour over it, and repeat so the block gets smaller each time.
points: carve more of the same block
print colours in layers lightest to darkest

short.q: Describe two ways to create texture in printmaking.
short.model: Use a collagraph with glued string, card or fabric, or add marks by rolling ink over a textured surface or by carving varied marks into the lino.

short.q: Why combine materials in mixed media?
short.model: It adds contrast and texture, and allows you to show different qualities, as long as a repeated colour or shape unites the materials.

short.q: How would you show AO2 in a collage?
short.model: Make several collage tests with different materials and layering, review each against your intention, and select and refine the best with a reason.
He built Merz collages from found rubbish, such as tickets, newspaper and scraps, arranged into abstract compositions.
